items.title: Pay invoice for December 2026 flex desk and meeting room
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: Invoice date is 21 November 2026. The 14-day period is triggered by an event (issuance of the invoice), so under § 187(1) BGB the day of the event itself is not counted; the period starts on 22 November 2026. Counting 14 days from there (22 Nov = day 1 ... 5 Dec = day 14) gives a nominal last day of 5 December 2026. That day is a Saturday; under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. Monday 7 December 2026 is not a public holiday in NRW, so the payment is due on 7 December 2026.

warnings: The letter mentions that late payment 'may pause your access card', which is a service consequence rather than a legal deadline; no formal dunning or legal remedy procedure is indicated in this invoice.
